name: wallet-review
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production animation keyframe sprite sheet, precisely 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, 2048x2048 pixels. Read frame order left to right then top to bottom. Input is the identity reference. Preserve this exact Kuponi character: cobalt blue rounded square soft 3D body, large white eyes dark pupils dark rounded eyebrows, no nose, short blue feet and mitten hands, graphite magnifying glass with blue lens ALWAYS held in his right hand. No clothes, no hats, no lettering, no numbers, no borders, no grid lines, no labels. Truly transparent alpha background, NOT checkerboard. Fixed orthographic camera and lighting, full body in every cell, centered identically at same scale, soles baseline at 85% cell height. Body occupies 58% of cell height, all props fit with generous safe margins. This is a sequence of distinct but closely related motion keyframes for a 12-second story, NOT 16 unrelated illustrations. Preserve facial geometry between frames. Same prop geometry and count throughout. Gradual changes with no sudden camera or scale changes.
A calm wallet review: a small tan wallet is on the ground to his left throughout. Frames 1-4: Kuponi looks down, lowers magnifier toward open wallet, leans slightly toward it. 5-8: slowly examines wallet left to right with lens, eyebrows raise in recognition. 9-12: straightens, free left hand open-palmed toward viewer-left (toward the real balance UI outside image), soft proud smile. 13-16: slight confirming nod, lowers arm and rests beside wallet. No coins flying, no celebration jump. Wallet remains open and stationary throughout.
